diff --git a/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/tests/test_checkins.py b/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/tests/test_checkins.py
index 93ecb06..7b47c18 100644
--- a/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/tests/test_checkins.py
+++ b/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/tests/test_checkins.py
@@ -1,6 +1,25 @@
+from openlibrary.plugins.upstream import checkins
 from openlibrary.plugins.upstream.checkins import check_ins
 
 
+def test_module_date_string_formats_partial_dates_and_zero_pads_components():
+    assert checkins.make_date_string(1998, None, None) == '1998'
+    assert checkins.make_date_string(1998, 2, None) == '1998-02'
+    assert checkins.make_date_string(1998, 2, 9) == '1998-02-09'
+    assert checkins.make_date_string(1998, None, 9) == '1998'
+    assert checkins.make_date_string(1998, 0, 0) == '1998-00-00'
+
+
+def test_patron_check_in_update_requires_id_and_updatable_content():
+    validator = checkins.patron_check_ins()
+    assert validator.is_valid({'id': 1, 'year': 2000}) is True
+    assert validator.is_valid({'id': 1, 'data': {}}) is True
+    assert validator.is_valid({'year': 2000}) is False
+    assert validator.is_valid({'data': {}}) is False
+    assert validator.is_valid({'id': 1}) is False
+    assert validator.is_valid({'id': 1, 'month': 2, 'day': 9}) is False
+
+
 class TestMakeDateString:
     def setup_method(self):
         self.checkins = check_ins()
